placements.title: Missing an explicit id, the pipeline must still resolve one
placements.frame: When a memory arrives without an explicit id, does the pipeline's fallback path (LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify) reliably produce a slug and commit the file?
placements.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition (no explicit id field on submission) and src-2 states the recurring pipeline requirement this condition activates — resolve a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback, then commit. Together they name a subject future envelopes about id-less submissions will keep feeding (fallback correctness, commit success), not a one-time fact, so they ground a new leaf rather than a position. Nothing in the supplied structure or strata (both empty for this repo) comes close, so this is a standalone NEW mint with no forced under.
